name: io.yof/yof
title: yof
description: Checks AI-written code for leaked keys and made-up packages, on your machine. Never uploads code.

environmentVariables.name: YOF_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. The key the yof dashboard makes for this connection (Connect your AI builder). Without it, only the local tools run.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer followed by the key the yof dashboard makes for this connection.
